note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The route, its stops and dates are supplied and editable, shown in the configured order ('Sequence as configured (illustrative)'). The substituted datum is the supplied state of one leg: documented (solid outline, ●) or questioned in this configured example (dashed outline — the disputed marker — ◆). Nothing states a valid method, a deadline, 'deemed' service, a winner or any effect. The long-labels-stress preset is not capped: every field is at near-maximum length.
